title: The Chatty Barista
description: Order a drink from a cafe worker who loves to talk.

easy.firstMessageEn: Welcome! What can I get you?
easy.missionDescription: You are at a cafe. Order a drink you like. The staff will ask you a few questions.
easy.goalCondition: You order one drink and answer the staff's questions about it.

normal.firstMessage: 안녕하세요! 오늘 딸기 라떼가 정말 맛있어요. 어떤 걸로 드릴까요?
normal.firstMessageEn: Hi! The strawberry latte is really good today. What would you like?
normal.missionDescription: The staff keeps recommending drinks. Ask about one drink, then order what you really want.
normal.goalCondition: You ask one question about a drink and order a drink with your choice of size or hot or iced.
normal.languageCondition: Use polite -요 endings and at least one connector such as -고 or -아서/어서.
steps: Say where you will drink it

hard.firstMessage: 어서 오세요! 아, 죄송한데 지금 우유가 다 떨어져서 라떼 종류는 주문이 어려워요. 다른 음료 괜찮으시겠어요?
hard.firstMessageEn: Welcome! Oh, I'm sorry, we just ran out of milk, so we can't make lattes right now. Would another drink be okay?
hard.missionDescription: You wanted a latte, but the cafe has no milk. Find out what you can have and make your order.
hard.goalCondition: You ask about other drinks, compare at least two of them and order one.

title: Grandma's Restaurant
description: A warm restaurant owner wants to feed you far too much.

easy.firstMessageEn: Come on in! What will you have?
easy.missionDescription: You are at a small Korean restaurant. The owner is very kind. Order one dish and answer her questions.
easy.goalCondition: You order one dish and say if you like spicy food.
steps: Say if you like spicy food

normal.firstMessage: 어서 와요! 혼자 왔어요? 오늘은 김치찌개가 맛있어요. 여기 앉아요.
normal.firstMessageEn: Come on in! Are you alone? The kimchi stew is good today. Sit here.
normal.missionDescription: The owner recommends food you can't eat. Tell her, order something else and say no to extra food.
normal.goalCondition: You say one food you can't eat, order another dish and politely say no to something extra.
normal.languageCondition: Use polite -요 endings. Use -아서/어서 to give a reason.

hard.firstMessage: 아이고, 비 오는데 오느라 고생했네요. 여기 앉아요. 배고파 보이는데, 오늘은 내가 많이 줄게요. 뭐 먹을래요?
hard.firstMessageEn: Oh my, you came all the way in the rain. Sit here. You look hungry, so I'll give you plenty today. What would you like?
hard.missionDescription: The owner wants to give you far too much. Order what you want, explain an allergy and refuse without hurting her feelings.
hard.goalCondition: You order a dish, explain one allergy and politely refuse the extra food without being rude.
hard.languageCondition: Use natural, polite spoken Korean that shows respect for an older person.

title: Midnight Convenience Store
description: Buy a late snack from a very sleepy part-timer.

easy.missionDescription: It is late at night. You are buying a snack at a convenience store. Answer the clerk and pay.
easy.goalCondition: You answer the clerk's questions, including one about a bag, and pay for your snack.

normal.firstMessage: 어서 오세요… 아, 이 라면 지금 하나 사면 하나 더 줘요. 하나 더 가져올래요?
normal.firstMessageEn: Welcome... Oh, this ramen is buy one, get one free right now. Do you want to grab another?
normal.missionDescription: The sleepy clerk tells you about a deal. Ask about it, decide and pay the way you want.
normal.goalCondition: You ask one question about the deal, decide what to buy and say how you will pay.
normal.languageCondition: Use polite -요 endings and simple questions.

hard.firstMessage: 어… 잠시만요, 손님. 이 도시락 유통기한이 지나서 계산이 안 되네요. 다른 걸로 가져오시겠어요?
hard.firstMessageEn: Uh... one moment, please. This lunch box is past its date, so it won't scan. Could you bring another one?
hard.missionDescription: Your lunch box can't be sold. Find something else to eat and ask to heat it up here.
hard.goalCondition: You ask what else is available, choose a replacement and ask where you can heat it up.

title: The Talkative Taxi Driver
description: Get where you are going with a driver full of questions.

easy.missionDescription: You got in a taxi. Tell the driver where you want to go. The driver likes to talk.
easy.goalCondition: You say where you are going and answer the driver's questions.

normal.firstMessage: 어서 오세요! 어디로 모실까요? 오늘 길이 좀 막혀요.
normal.firstMessageEn: Welcome! Where can I take you? Traffic is a bit heavy today.
normal.missionDescription: Traffic is bad and you have somewhere to be. Tell the driver your plan and check the time.
normal.goalCondition: You say where you are going, say when you must arrive and ask how long it will take.
normal.languageCondition: Use polite -요 endings and at least one time expression.

hard.firstMessage: 어서 오세요, 어디로 모실까요? 아, 그쪽은 지금 공사 중이라 좀 돌아가야 하는데 괜찮으시겠어요?
hard.firstMessageEn: Welcome, where can I take you? Oh, that way is under construction, so we'd have to go around. Would that be okay?
hard.missionDescription: You have a train to catch and the road is closed. Work out a route with the driver.
hard.goalCondition: You explain your time limit and agree with the driver on a route or a different place to get off.

title: Lost in the Neighborhood
description: Ask the way from a kind woman who is in a hurry.

easy.firstMessageEn: Yes? Are you looking for something?
easy.missionDescription: You are lost. Ask this woman how to get to the subway station.
easy.goalCondition: You ask where the subway station is and check the way she tells you.
steps: Say where you want to go

normal.firstMessage: 어머, 길 찾아요? 제가 좀 바쁜데, 어디 가요?
normal.firstMessageEn: Oh, are you looking for somewhere? I'm a bit busy, but where are you going?
normal.missionDescription: You need to find the post office. She is busy, so ask quickly and clearly.
normal.goalCondition: You ask how to get to the post office and how long it takes on foot.
normal.languageCondition: Use polite -요 endings and simple questions.

hard.firstMessage: 아, 네. 어디 찾으세요? 이 근처 길이 좀 복잡해서요. 저도 버스 타러 가는 길이니까 걸어가면서 말씀드릴게요.
hard.firstMessageEn: Oh, yes. Where are you trying to go? The streets around here are a bit confusing. I'm heading to the bus too, so I'll tell you as we walk.
hard.missionDescription: The way is complicated and she talks fast. Ask, repeat what you heard and ask for something to look out for.
hard.goalCondition: You ask the way, repeat the directions to check them and ask about a landmark.

title: At the Doctor's
description: Explain how you feel to a calm, careful doctor.

easy.firstMessageEn: Come in. Where does it hurt?
easy.missionDescription: You don't feel well. Tell the doctor where it hurts and answer the questions.
easy.goalCondition: You say where it hurts and answer the doctor's questions.

normal.firstMessage: 어서 오세요. 오늘은 어디가 불편해서 오셨어요?
normal.firstMessageEn: Come in. What's bothering you today?
normal.missionDescription: You have felt sick for a few days. Explain how you feel and find out what to do.
normal.goalCondition: You explain how you feel, say when it started and ask what you should do.
normal.languageCondition: Use polite -요 endings and past tense for when it started.

hard.firstMessage: 안녕하세요, 앉으세요. 열이 좀 있으시네요. 언제부터 그러셨는지, 다른 증상은 없는지 말씀해 주시겠어요?
hard.firstMessageEn: Hello, please have a seat. You have a bit of a fever. Could you tell me when it started and whether you have any other symptoms?
hard.missionDescription: You are sick and have an important exam tomorrow. Get advice and ask for a doctor's note.
hard.goalCondition: You describe your symptoms, ask about medicine and rest and ask for a doctor's note.

title: Weekend Plans with a Friend
description: Make plans in casual Korean with a playful best friend.

easy.firstMessageEn: Hey! What are you doing this weekend?
easy.missionDescription: Your best friend wants to meet this weekend. Talk in casual Korean and make a plan.
easy.goalCondition: You and your friend decide what to do and when to meet.

normal.firstMessage: 야, 너 토요일에 시간 있어? 나 진짜 맛있는 식당 찾았어!
normal.firstMessageEn: Hey, are you free on Saturday? I found a really good restaurant!
normal.missionDescription: Your friend found a restaurant, but plans change quickly with this friend. Settle the details.
normal.goalCondition: You and your friend agree on a day, a time and a place to meet.
steps: Agree on a day and time

hard.firstMessage: 야, 미안한데 토요일 약속 있잖아. 나 그날 갑자기 알바 잡혀서 못 갈 것 같아. 어떡하지?
hard.firstMessageEn: Hey, sorry, about our plans on Saturday. I suddenly got a work shift that day, so I don't think I can make it. What should we do?
hard.missionDescription: Your friend has to cancel at the last minute. React naturally and make a new plan.
hard.goalCondition: You react to the news, suggest another day and agree on a new plan.

title: The Roommate Problem
description: Your neat roommate has a complaint, and this time you are guilty.

easy.missionDescription: Your roommate can't find their milk. You drank it! Tell the truth and fix it.
easy.goalCondition: You say you drank the milk, say sorry and say you will buy more.
steps: Say how you will fix it

normal.firstMessage: 야, 부엌에 설거지가 또 그대로야. 네가 어제 먹었지?
normal.firstMessageEn: Hey, the dishes in the kitchen are still sitting there again. You ate last night, right?
normal.missionDescription: You left the dishes again. Explain why, say sorry and agree on a plan.
normal.goalCondition: You explain why the dishes were left, say sorry and agree on who will wash them from now on.
normal.languageCondition: Use casual Korean (반말). Use -아서/어서 to give a reason.

hard.firstMessage: 우리 얘기 좀 하자. 요즘 네 친구들이 너무 자주 오는 것 같아. 어제도 밤늦게까지 시끄러워서 잠을 못 잤어.
hard.firstMessageEn: We need to talk. Your friends come over too often these days. Last night it was loud until late and I couldn't sleep.
hard.missionDescription: Your roommate is upset about your friends visiting. Listen, give your side and find a fair rule.
hard.goalCondition: You accept the complaint, explain your side and agree on a rule for visitors.
hard.languageCondition: Use natural casual Korean (반말) without sounding rude.

title: Talking to Your Boss
description: Ask a strict but fair team leader for something difficult.

easy.missionDescription: You want Friday off. Ask your boss and answer the questions.
easy.goalCondition: You ask for Friday off and say why.

normal.firstMessage: 아, 마침 잘 왔어요. 어제 부탁한 보고서, 오늘까지 될까요?
normal.firstMessageEn: Ah, good timing. Will the report I asked for yesterday be done today?
normal.missionDescription: The report isn't finished. Tell your boss honestly and ask for more time.
normal.goalCondition: You say the report isn't finished, explain why and say when you can finish it.

hard.firstMessage: 잠깐 볼까요? 오늘 회의 자료에 숫자가 틀린 부분이 있던데요. 어떻게 된 건지 설명 좀 해 주세요.
hard.firstMessageEn: Can I see you for a moment? Some of the numbers in today's meeting materials were wrong. Please explain what happened.
hard.missionDescription: There was a mistake in your meeting materials. Admit it, explain it and offer a solution.
hard.goalCondition: You admit the mistake, explain the cause and suggest how you will fix it.

title: Office Hours with the Professor
description: Visit your strict but warm professor during office hours.

easy.firstMessageEn: Yes, come in. What is it?
easy.missionDescription: You don't understand the homework. Go to your professor and ask.
easy.goalCondition: You say you don't understand the homework and ask what to do.

normal.firstMessage: 어서 와요. 앉아요. 오늘은 무슨 일로 왔어요?
normal.firstMessageEn: Come in. Have a seat. What brings you here today?
normal.missionDescription: You can't finish your assignment by the deadline. Explain and ask for more time.
normal.goalCondition: You explain your situation, ask for more time and agree on a new date.
normal.languageCondition: Use polite -요 or -습니다 endings. Don't use casual Korean with a professor.

hard.firstMessage: 어서 와요. 지난번 발표 말인데, 내용은 좋았는데 자료 출처가 좀 부족했어요. 어떻게 준비했는지 말해 볼래요?
hard.firstMessageEn: Come in. About your last presentation, the content was good, but it was short on sources. Can you tell me how you prepared?
hard.missionDescription: Your professor has feedback on your presentation. Explain your work and ask how to make it better.
hard.goalCondition: You explain how you prepared, ask how to improve and ask for a chance to fix it.
hard.languageCondition: Use respectful Korean, including polite words for a professor.

title: The Wrong Size
description: Exchange clothes with a sweet clerk who never breaks the rules.

easy.firstMessageEn: Welcome! What are you looking for?
easy.missionDescription: You bought a shirt, but it is too small. Ask to change it.
easy.goalCondition: You say the shirt is too small and ask for a bigger one.

normal.firstMessage: 어서 오세요! 어, 이 옷 여기서 사셨어요? 무슨 문제가 있으세요?
normal.firstMessageEn: Welcome! Oh, did you buy this here? Is something wrong with it?
normal.missionDescription: You want to bring back a jacket you bought. Explain the problem and choose what to do.
normal.goalCondition: You explain the problem, answer about the receipt and choose an exchange or a refund.
normal.languageCondition: Use polite -요 endings. Use -아서/어서 to give a reason.

hard.firstMessage: 어서 오세요. 아, 이 옷은 세일 상품이라 환불은 안 되고 교환만 가능해요. 혹시 영수증 갖고 계세요?
hard.firstMessageEn: Welcome. Oh, this was a sale item, so we can't refund it, only exchange it. Do you happen to have your receipt?
hard.missionDescription: Your sale item has a hole, but the store says no refunds. Politely argue your case and reach a solution.
hard.goalCondition: You explain the defect, politely ask for a refund or another solution and agree on one.
hard.languageCondition: Use natural, polite spoken Korean. Stay polite while disagreeing.

title: Hotel Check-In
description: Check in with an extremely polite hotel clerk.

easy.firstMessageEn: Hello! Do you have a reservation?
easy.missionDescription: You arrived at your hotel. Check in and ask about breakfast.
easy.goalCondition: You say you have a reservation, say your name and ask about breakfast.

normal.firstMessage: 어서 오십시오, 고객님. 체크인 도와드릴까요? 성함이 어떻게 되세요?
normal.firstMessageEn: Welcome. May I help you check in? May I have your name?
normal.missionDescription: Check in at the hotel, then find out what you need to know for your stay.
normal.goalCondition: You give your name and how many nights you are staying, and ask when and where breakfast is.

hard.firstMessage: 어서 오십시오, 고객님. 정말 죄송합니다만, 예약하신 방이 아직 준비되지 않아 한 시간 정도 기다리셔야 할 것 같습니다.
hard.firstMessageEn: Welcome. I'm terribly sorry, but the room you reserved isn't ready, so you may have to wait about an hour.
hard.missionDescription: Your room isn't ready and you have a meeting soon. Find out why and work out a solution.
hard.goalCondition: You ask why, explain your situation and agree on a solution such as storing your bags or another room.
hard.languageCondition: Use natural, polite spoken Korean. Stay polite when you complain.
